Skipped: about 15 claims without a number or without a date, for example CRISPR monogenic market USD 75 billion per year and CAR-T USD 250 billion per year (no year), 'ARK expects CRISPR to enter human trials in 2018' (dated, not numeric), the cryptoasset expectations (no number), and GE's own 2020 3D printing targets (GE's forecast, not ARK's).
